articleTitle: Enhancing COVID-19 Safety: Automatic Mask Detection and Temperature Monitoring System using YOLOv5x and Mobile App Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: COVID-19 has several effects and disruptions to all sides of daily life. To minimize this effect, face mask should be worn to control its dangerous. To avoid the manual personal checking of the mask, which is a difficult and disturbing issue, the suggested idea is to develop an auto mask-checking based on mobile phone application platform that could be continuously running in real-time leading to a more beneficial and cheap surveillance system. Quite modern object detection platform, called, you only look once version 5x (yOLOv5x) is considered to realize this function. The model is trained using a custom -created dataset grouping mask/unmask persons' pictures. The model is invoked in Google Colab, transformed to a mobile application based on a light version of YOLOv5x, and then tested in real-time on a mobile phone. The application has also the capability for checking facemasks for a group of individuals in real-time with high-speed inference. Body temperature is also incorporated for each person using IR touchless sensor and monitored on the application interface. The developed real-time detector system is small-sized, low cost, lightweight, and fast response time, reaching 98.8% training\testing accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Concurrent Assessment of Image Quality Score and Distortion With Context-Fovea Integrated CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: This paper proposes a compact framework for simultaneous prediction of image quality scores and corresponding distortion types utilizing a convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture with three integrated streams: a context stream to learn low-resolution features and two fovea streams to learn high-resolution features that operate on the center region. We evaluate the proposed method on the TID2013 and KADID-10k databases by focusing on four prevalent distortions including Gaussian noise, Gaussian blur, JPEG compression, and JPEG2000 compression. Through empirical evaluation, we demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed architecture in accurately predicting quality scores and distortion types. In KADID-10k, the proposed method achieves a distortion classification accuracy of 90.741%, with Pearson correlation coefficients of 94.067% for score prediction and Spearman correlation coefficients of 93.333%. Similarly, in TID2013, the proposed method attains distortion classification accuracy of 92.087%, with Pearson correlation coefficients of 95.062% for score prediction and Spearman correlation coefficients of 96.279%. The experimental results prove the effectiveness of the proposed context and fovea stream CNN architecture for simultaneous IQA and distortion classification.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Noise Detector for Patient Monitoring at Hospital Wards
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Noise pollution in healthcare ward environments poses a significant concern, affecting patient health and well-being. Traditional methods of monitoring and managing noise, such as limited rounds and CCTV observation, prove ineffective in providing optimal patient care. This issue becomes particularly critical for patients recovering from major surgeries, as excessive noise can lead to discomfort, mental distress, and potential health complications. To reduce the noise, there is a need to adopt various technologies that can monitor the noise and reduce it. In response, this paper aims to develop a real time noise monitoring system using loT devices to monitor real-time noise in hospital wards. This system can identify sources and alert user when it exceeds the standard level. A case study is carried out to ascertain the noise pollution at one public hospital in Klang Valley, Malaysia. Establishing the average decibel is crucial to determining the appropriate levels, as recommended by the Worldwide Health Organization (WHO), for the patient's stay, health, and the safety of the medical staff. This project can effectively demonstrate the purpose of advocating for sustainable development goals, particularly in the areas of health and wellbeing.

articleTitle: Collaborative Active Learning in Conditional Trust Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate collaborative active learning, a paradigm in which multiple collaborators explore a new domain by leveraging their combined machine learning capabilities without disclosing their existing data and models. Instead, the collaborators share prediction results from the new domain and newly acquired labels. This collaboration offers several advantages: (a) it addresses privacy and security concerns by eliminating the need for direct model and data disclosure; (b) it enables the use of different data sources and insights without direct data exchange; and (c) it promotes cost-effectiveness and resource efficiency through shared labeling costs. To realize these benefits, we introduce a collaborative active learning framework designed to fulfill the aforementioned objectives. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework through simulations. The results demonstrate that collaboration leads to higher AUC scores compared to independent efforts, highlighting the frame-work's ability to overcome the limitations of individual models. These findings support the use of collaborative approaches in active learning, emphasizing their potential to enhance outcomes through collective expertise and shared resources. Our work provides a foundation for further research on collaborative active learning and its practical applications in various domains where data privacy, cost efficiency, and model performance are critical considerations.

articleTitle: DA Strategy Implementation toward Optimization Problems: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Real-world problems demand an optimal solution within an acceptable time. Normally the problems are compound in nature, often not polynomials (NP-Problem) based on complexity theory. One of the approaches to solving real-world problems is optimization. The latest development of optimization known as intelligent optimization (IO) or specifically meta-heuristic optimization has the characteristics and capability to tackle these real-world problems. In 2016 the Dragonfly Algorithm (DA) strategy was developed for meta-heuristic optimization purposes. Since then, the DA has gathered the thrust of the research community by implementing it across multiple research domains and applications. This systematic literature review (SLR) article has been introduced with the intent to dissect and analyze the DA strategy implementation toward optimization problems. Guided with the PRISMA method, a total of 62 related research studies have been identified and eligible for further analysis. The analysis has been done with the consideration of three main elements which are the DA variant, application field, and benefited research domain. Based on the obtained SLR analyzed data, several discussions, opinions, and recommendations have been thoughtfully presented.

Index Terms: Preferred Reporting Items For Systematic Reviews And Meta-Analyses

articleTitle: Influence on Electrical Properties of Copper Doped Zinc Oxide and Polylactic Acid Composite Thin Films Using Immersion Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: The ZnO and Cu: ZnO powder were synthesized using immersion method, then ZnO/PLA an 0.5 at % Cu:ZnO/PLA composite thin films were prepared to create a triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs). Sharp peaks in the X-ray diffraction (XRD) study showed that the composite films had sharp crystallinity. The addition of 0.5 at. % Cu doping markedly improved the electrical performance of the TENGs devices. Due to the enhanced carrier concentration brought about by Cu doping, the 0.5 at. % Cu:ZnO/PLA TENGs produced higher voltage outputs than the undoped ZnO/PLA TENGs. The experimental study on the capacitor charging characteristics were tested with capacitors of varying values (1 μF, 4.7 μF, and 10 μF) connected to the rectified voltage output. These findings show Cu doping significantly the materials' potential for effective energy storage. This shows the significant gains in TEN Gs device performance and efficiency through optimization of Cu doping levels.

articleTitle: A Highly Reliable XNOR-XOR-RO PUF Design for IoT Security Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: PUFs or Physical Unclonable Function is now an emerging trend for hardware and IoT (internet-of-things) security solutions. IoT solutions always have a poor security features and are vulnerable to external attacks. Hence, a highly reliable security solution is important for their implementation. This work presents a highly reliable physical unclonable function implemented in an FPGA for use in IoT security. The proposed PUF is implemented in Xilinx ZYNQ 7000 FPGA board and operates at 100 MHz. A novel XNX (XNOR-XOR) Ring Oscillator (RO) PUF with configurable frequency is presented in this report. A statistical measure is used to report the experiments done in the design. The proposed design gives a highly reliable output of 99.86%, uniqueness of 49.90%, and a uniformity of 67.30%. The proposed design offered the most reliable design compared to previous works.

articleTitle: A 66.077-mW Output-Power PZE Energy Harvesting Circuit with Boost Converter Using Impedance Matching PWM/PFM Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: This paper proposes a piezoelectric energy harvesting circuit for the Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV). Because of the tremendous vibration of the ocean wave, the piezoeletric (PZE) transducer would generate the power of several tens mW. The Active Rectifier is used as the AC-DC converter. The Boost Converter is employed to boost the DC voltage to meet the requirement for the Li-ion battery. To improve the output power, the impedance matching between the Active Rectifier and the Boost Converter with a PWM/PFM control circuit is proposed. The proposed design is implemented with a typical 0.18 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> CMOS process. The core area is 979.54 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\times$</tex> 979.54 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{m}^{2}$</tex>. The peak efficiency of the energy harvesting circuit is 91.87%, with the maximum output power of 66.077 mW.

articleTitle: Enhancing Forest Fire Management in Malaysia with a Power BI Dashboard: Leveraging VIIRS Hotspots and Environmental Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Addressing the growing threat of forest fires intensified by climate change and human activities, this study leverages the Microsoft Power BI dashboard to enhance forest fire management in Malaysia. Utilizing the VIIRS 375 m Active Fire product data from NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) alongside meteorological variables (wind speed, precipitation, and temperature) from the NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project, the dashboard harnesses Power Bl's capabilities to offer a user-friendly interface that dynamically visualizes data on fire occurrences, environmental conditions, and trend analyses. This tool is aimed at supporting proactive forest fire management strategies, thereby safeguarding Malaysia's natural landscapes and communities by facilitating improved monitoring, analysis, and predictive forecasting of fire events. Through the integration of satellite-based observations and environmental data from NASA's initiatives, the dashboard is designed to offer critical insights and effective forest fire mitigation efforts in Malaysia.

articleTitle: Optimization of Design Parameters Using Taguchi Method for Thermal Stress Analysis in a 3D IC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Thermal stress and deformation analysis plays an important role in understanding the effects of heat on the performance and reliability of a 3D integrated circuit (IC) design. The demand for smaller and powerful electronic devices, 3D IC design gained prominence due to their superior integration capabilities. The IC's components dissipate heat across several chip regions, which may cause localized overheating and a decline in performance and reliability. Hence, there is a growing need for innovative solutions to address this issue. The main objective of this project is to develop a 3D IC thermal model using Ansys Software. The study also aims to optimize the design parameters to predict the hot spots region in the 3D IC. The size of the intermetallic compound (IMC) joint, chip thickness, and load temperature were chosen as factors to evaluate the effect of various variables on the thermal stress of the 3D IC. The findings suggest that the temperature loading has a substantial impact on the thermal stress experienced by the 3D IC model. The IMC joint and chip interface were identified as the critical locations where higher thermal stress were perceived. Upon optimizing the variables, the thermal stress and deformation experienced a reduction of 1.25% and 0.36% respectively. In summary, the most effective design parameters for this study were determined to be a chip size of 0.9 mm, an IMC joint size of 0.1 mm, and a chip thickness of 0.12 mm. These parameters were obtained under the temperature load of 60 °C.

articleTitle: 5G-Connected UAV Handovers in Agricultural Environments: Palm Oil Plantations Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have become a focal point in various industries like agriculture, emergency response, and package delivery. The utilization of cellular networks for operating UAVs holds great potential in overcoming the challenges of remote navigation and long-distance flight, enabling UAVs to operate beyond the operator's line of sight. In agricultural settings, like oil palm farms, implementing fifth-generation (5G) cellular technology in UAVs promises efficiency, sustainability, and better yields through real-time surveillance, early disease detection, precise pesticide application, yield calculation, and environmental impact assessment are examples of these. Although there is a lot of potential for integrating 5G cellular connectivity with UAVs, there are certain practical difficulties, particularly with regard to handovers. This work explores the feasibility of handovers for 5G-connected UAVs in palm oil plantations. Radio Mobile simulations in these areas will analyze signal strengths between UAVs and base stations (BSs) across various heights and distances. Results will guide the establishment of optimal parameters for high-performing 5G-connected UAVs in such settings.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of 5G Cellular-Connected UAV in Palm Oil Plantation Using Antenna Beamforming
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: The oil palm industry in Malaysia faces challenges due to limited resources for monitoring plantations, leading to significant losses in time and finances. To enhance efficiency, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV s) are proposed as a solution, leveraging 5G technology crucial for IoT applications in agriculture. Cellular-connected UAVs, especially those using 5G, hold promise across industries, operating in risky environments and conducting surveys at great heights. However, received signals from the base station weaken as UAV altitude increases, posing a challenge and limiting the UAV's operational altitude. Thus, optimizing UAV antennas becomes crucial for signal reception at higher altitudes. This study aims to formulate antenna beamforming strategies to improve 5G network performance in palm oil plantations. Simulation using MATLAB's Antenna Toolbox estimates the uplink transmission capacity at various UAV distances and elevations. Findings reveal the potential for high-speed uplink transmission using a 3×3 array microstrip patch antenna, surpassing non-array antennas. Additionally, findings demonstrate that optimal uplink capacity performance can be achieved by using a beamforming antenna which combines two microstrip patch antennas oriented at 90° and 135°. These insights highlight the potential of UAVs and antenna optimization in revolutionizing monitoring and data transmission efficiency in oil palm plantations.

articleTitle: Resampling Methods for Imbalanced Datasets in Multi-Label Classification: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: One of the most prevalent issues in the classification field is an imbalanced dataset. Because an instance can be assigned to more than one class label, multi-label categorization introduces complexity. The resampling technique is the most used approach to handle imbalanced problems because it is classifier-independent. The objective of this paper is to review resampling techniques that are already utilized to overcome the imbalanced issues in multi-label classification and to know what the insights and research gaps are. Some approaches are reviewed and analyzed to propose some challenges and research prospects.

articleTitle: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies in the Next Phase of Digital Business Transformation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: This paper explores the complexities of current trends and technological progress that are influencing the future of digital business transformation. This analysis explores the significant impact of integrating artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) into different aspects of business operations, including business models, customer experiences, and innovation. In addition, we examine the growing importance of e-commerce, digital marketing, and online platforms, specifically considering the interest in social media and travel. This paper aims to provide insights into the opportunities and challenges in the dynamic landscape, drawing from the intersection of computer science and business.

articleTitle: Classification of Defect and Non-Defect Durian Using Image Processing Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Durian, a renowned fruit in Southeast Asia, particularly in countries like Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia, poses a challenge during its season as the manual classification of a large stock of durians based on grade and quality becomes a laborious task for sellers. This project aims to streamline the process by employing image processing techniques for the classification of durians into defect and non-defect categories. The methodology involves image collection and image filtering analysis using Gaussian and Median filters, followed by applying Canny edge detection techniques to identify the durian region. Subsequently, classification algorithms based on pixel connection are deployed to distinguish between defect and non-defect durians. The obtained results reveal comparable accuracy and precision rates for both defect and non-defect durian images, standing at 87% and 75%, respectively. This project successfully demonstrates the feasibility of automating durian classification through image processing methods.

articleTitle: Hybrid Neuro Genetic Causal Convolution based Autoencoders, for Traffic Prediction in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: This research presents a novel approach to traffic prediction in smart cities using Hybrid Neuro-Genetic Causal Convolution based Autoencoders (HNG-CCA). Urban traffic congestion has become a significant challenge in modern urban planning, necessitating accurate and efficient predictive models. In this work, we propose a hybrid architecture that combines neuro-genetic techniques with causal convolutional autoencoders to enhance the predictive capabilities of traffic patterns. The neuro-genetic approach optimizes the autoencoder architecture, while the causal convolutional layers capture the temporal dependencies inherent in traffic data. Our experiments on real-world traffic datasets demonstrate that the HNG-CCA outperforms existing methods in terms of prediction accuracy and generalization. This hybrid approach not only contributes to the field of traffic prediction but also showcases the potential of combining diverse machine learning paradigms to address complex urban challenges in smart cities.

articleTitle: Personalized Glove as User Interface for Disabled Person Monitoring System Using ESP32
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: This paper shares the development of a disabled person monitoring system by a personalized glove using ESP32 board. The disabled person need was monitored through the personalized glove that was fixed with flex sensors for each finger; where for each hand gesture detected by the system, the respective output will be displayed on the LCD and by the speaker that plays the related command. The hand gesture was detected based on the flex sensors resistance value produced depending on the finger's bending movement. The developed system had been tested and resulted in 90% accuracy for the hand gesture recognition through the threshold set for the system. Later if the system is to be used for a specific user, the threshold value for each finger's flex sensor can be adjusted accordingly to increase the accuracy of the personalized glove monitoring system. The work shared in this paper shows that a disabled person needs can be conveyed through a glove fixed with flex sensors as the disabled person user interface, eliminating the need of the person to reach for specific button or devices to signal their alerts.

articleTitle: Fractional-Order Model Predictive Controller for Process Plant's Robust Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)

authors.preferredName: Muhammad Aidi Farhan bin Mohamed Sadik

abstract: Recent research has explored fractional order model predictive control (FOMPC) in various control systems, including power energy, thermal, medical instrumentation, and movement control. Thus, this study focuses on developing a FOMPC model for process plants and comparing its robust performance with linear Model Predictive Control (MPC). The objective is to evaluate the effectiveness of FOMPC in handling multiple set points and disturbances and implement it in process plants. MATLAB/SIMULINK software simulates the process plant per-formance, derives the targeted transfer function, and implements FOMPC using Oustaloup's approximation. The comparison be-tween MPC and FOMPC will involve performance measures, including rise time, settling time, overshoot, and steady-state.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of 5G Performance in Indoor and Outdoor Environments Across Key Urban Areas in Bangkok
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Effective communication is essential in today's world. With the advancement of technology, people's lives have undergone significant changes, impacting various aspects such as shopping, conducting business through online platforms, and acquiring knowledge. In this context, a reliable internet signal plays a crucial role. In Thailand, 5G signals are already in use. However, there are still some areas in Thailand where the stability of the 5G signal is not sufficient. This research compared 5G signals in key central areas of the country. In this comparison, two major companies were assessed in terms of 5G signal speed for downloading and uploading data. Data was collected both inside and outside buildings at crucial locations in Thailand using the same model of mobile phone, and the testing was conducted through the Speedtest program. The results revealed that there were no significant differences in the 5G signal download speeds between the two companies, both inside and outside buildings (AIS 300.45 Mbps, TRUE 284.37 Mbps). However, there was a notable disparity in the 5G signal data upload speeds within the buildings of the two companies (AIS 41.56 Mbps, TRUE 49.28 Mbps). Based on the research results, the data can be utilized to make informed decisions when choosing a 5G signal. Furthermore, these findings may contribute to the enhancement of 5G signals and potentially serve as a guide for the future development of 6G signals.

articleTitle: CloudCraft: Transforming Resume Management System With Dynamic Cloud Deployment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: CloudCraft represents a novel approach to web-based resume management systems, leveraging the power of cloud computing for dynamic deployment and customizable user experiences. Earlier the Resume Builder websites were not capable of providing drag and drop features of customizing the content like User Bio, Education Details, Work Experience etc. This is where our CloudCraft Solution come into picture where we overcome this problem by providing drag and drop features using JavaScript's Functions and Event Listeners. This paper also explores the integration of CloudCraft with AWS, providing users with a seamless and flexible platform to create, customize, and personalize resumes. The research delves into the architecture of the CloudCraft project, emphasizing its innovative use of Docker for containerization and AWS for scalable deployment. The user-centric design allows individuals to tailor their resumes effortlessly, enhancing their job application process. Security measures, including password encryption and JSON Web Tokens (JWT), ensure a secure client-server communication.

articleTitle: Cyber Risks and Blockchain Security for Digital Forensics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: In the 21st century, organizations heavily reliant on technology face concerns regarding cyber risks and vulnerabilities in the context of the Internet of Things (loT) and digital forensics. Various industrial financial services, particularly those utilizing sensor-based technology and loT devices, gain a significant advantage in digital forensic investigations due to a secure blockchain process. The proliferation of these technologies in sectors such as financial services has led to increased vulnerabilities that are often identified during digital forensic investigations, emphasizing the importance of focusing on data capture and data integrity. Recent years have witnessed a surge in serious cybersecurity threats, necessitating a strong connection between forensic investigation and blockchain technology. This paper explores the significance of a digital forensic report with a blockchain-based security framework. A notable challenge in digital forensics involves the difficulty in tracing and identifying malicious actors or illicit activities on the blockchain. Effective incident response and the ultimate investigation results play a crucial role in enhancing the security environment through blockchain technology. This research underscores the importance of securing the final investigation report using a blockchain process in the digital forensic context.

articleTitle: Inductive Logic Programming based Bottlenose Delphin Optimization to Fake new Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: The integration of Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) and Bottlenose Dolphin Optimization (BDO) in this research addresses a pressing issue in today's information-saturated landscape: the proliferation of fake news. In an era where misleading information can spread rapidly, traditional methods often fall short in effectively identifying deceptive content. To combat this challenge, our approach harnesses the synergies of ILP and BDO. ILP plays a crucial role in constructing logical rules that capture intricate relationships within news data. By doing so, it delves deep into the content, seeking out patterns and inconsistencies that may not be obvious at first glance. BDO, on the other hand, takes inspiration from the social behavior of bottlenose dolphins to optimize the process of generating these rules. Just as dolphins collaborate and communicate to solve complex problems, BDO helps refine the logical rules for better accuracy. Ultimately, this research underscores the potential of bio-inspired optimization, such as BDO, combined with the precision of logic programming (ILP) to strengthen the integrity of information dissemination platforms. In an age where the veracity of information is paramount, this innovative approach offers a promising solution to combat the spread of fake news and promote the dissemination of authentic, reliable information.

articleTitle: Impact of Retinal Enhancement Techniques on Blood Vessel Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: The accurate segmentation of retinal blood vessels is paramount in ophthalmology for diagnosing conditions such as glaucoma, hypertension, and diabetic retinopathy. Automatic segmentation methods play a crucial role in facilitating early detection and analysis of various eye-related diseases. This paper presents an investigation into the efficacy of an adaptive contrast enhancement technique designed to improve the quality of retinal fundus images specifically for vessel segmentation. The enhancement method is integrated with a refined filtering and noise reduction algorithm, complemented by padding and color standardization techniques to enhance image quality. The proposed approach is evaluated using two widely used datasets, DRIVE and CHASE-DBl, with a comprehensive comparison of segmentation performance before and after applying the enhancement technique. Visual inspection of the results demonstrates the superiority and appropriateness of the proposed method over alternative approaches, exhibiting enhanced vessel quality that aids in the early detection and analysis of various eye-related conditions.

articleTitle: An Optimized Kernel Grey Model for Carbon Dioxide Emissions Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: One of the most important prerequisites for educating people about the importance of a clean and healthy environment is the analysis and forecasting of carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions. Various approaches for forecasting CO2 emissions have been proposed. This paper proposes the kernel grey model (KGM(1,N) method based on genetic algorithm (GA-KGM(1,N)) to address the problem of CO2 emission prediction with small sample data. The genetic algorithm was used to optimize the kernel function parameter and penalty factor of KGM(1,N). Using CO2 emissions data from Malaysia, we presented case studies with numerical findings for predictive performance for the GA-KGM(1,N) model in comparison to the traditional GM(1,N) and the multivariate grey model GMC(1,N). The results show that when compared to the traditional GM(1,N) and GMC(1,N) models, GA-KGM(1,N) model can be applied to any combination factor of CO2 data and achieve higher fitting and prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Assessing Environmental Pollution and Noise Levels at End-of-Life Vehicle Recycling Centers: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: This study investigates the environmental impact of end-of-life vehicle (EL V) recycling operations by assessing pollution parameters and noise levels at formal and informal recycling centers compared to a green zone reference area. U sing an integrated monitoring system. This research measured concentrations of particulate matter (PM2.5, PMlO), nitrogen dioxide (N02), carbon dioxide (C02), ozone (03), and noise levels at selected sites in Selangor, Malaysia. Results reveal elevated pollutant concentrations and noise levels at both formal and informal EL V recycling centers relative to the green zone reference area. Diurnal variations in pollutant levels highlight the influence of operational activities and atmospheric conditions. The findings underscore the need for stringent regulatory measures and pollution control strategies to mitigate environmental and health risks associated with EL V recycling activities and promote sustainable practices in the recycling industry.

articleTitle: Preliminary Design of Water Intake System for In-Situ Water Quality Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Water quality at specific places is normally assessed by collecting water samples at site and transporting them to the laboratory for testing purposes. For in situ measurement, a popular method of collecting the samples is by using a conventional sample test kit such as syringe and cuvette. This approach, however, requires human intervention and needs to be done manually. The need for a mechanism to improve the sampling technique is crucial for in situ measurement such as for microfluidic and point-of-care devices. The aim of this work is to propose an intake system with the capability of controlling the samples that flow into the testing system. The circuit is designed and simulated using TinkerCAD software to observe and analyze the electrical characteristics of the proposed system in which a peristaltic pump is used as the main component in the intake system. Based on simulation work, 100 Ω rheostat setting between 10 to 50% was found to be suitable to drive a 12 V motor (representing a peristaltic pump) and satisfy the minimum operating current of 106.5 mA. The intake system was successfully developed to be capable of controlling the flow rate of intake samples through rheostat setting. At this range of rheostat setting, voltage characteristics for simulated and actual setup show similar patterns with less than 7% deviation. Through experiment, the system produced a range of flow rates between 0.842 ml<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s to 1.7549 ml<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s at controlling voltage from 6.2073 V to 10.5731 V. The relationship between the controlling voltage and flow intake was determined as a preliminary effort to develop a voltage-controlled intake system for multipurpose in situ application. Further improvement can be made by translating this voltage into its respective flow rate for display purposes and by integrating a commercial flow sensor for verification. This preliminary work could contribute to the future development of an intake system that is capable of performing a continuous and segmented automatic sampling to improve the traditional way of sampling process, which is manually done.

articleTitle: Wearable Detection System for Early Symptoms of Tantrums in Children Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Tantrums become one of the challenging parts for caregivers because the behavior that will occur when tantrums are crying, screaming, kicking, and hurting themselves. The severity and causes of tantrums are different in each child. Children generally experience tantrums if their wishes are not met and hear sounds that are too loud. When experiencing tantrums, the heart will work faster while pumping blood throughout the body so that the body temperature will experience changes, as well as causing sweat glands to excrete sweat on the skin's surface. To prevent dangerous things from happening during tantrums, a device detects the child's state when going into a temper by measuring heart rate, body temperature, skin conductance, and surrounding sound intensity. Measurement data from the sensors can be accessed on the Blynk application on the smartphone in real-time. When tantrum symptoms are detected, the caregiver's smartphone will be notified. This research produces a wearable system as a bracelet integrated with the IoT system to see early signs of tantrums in children.

articleTitle: Chick IT: A Smart Poultry Feeding System Through the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: The poultry industry constitutes a significant portion of the Philippine economy. In an increasingly technological society, the poultry industry also needs to adapt and maximize the recent technology to further enhance the efficiency of the poultry feeding system. The aim of this research is to develop a monitoring system employing sensors, NodeMCU ESP8266, and Arduino Cloud to remotely track the water levels and feed weight of poultry. The developers employed the Agile Methodology for the development of the project. Ten (10) experts in the field of information technology and computer engineering evaluated the prototype using ISO 9126 evaluation criteria. The Likert Scale was used to interpret the results. Based on the evaluation, the project received an overall mean of 3.06, indicating that it meets the requirements in terms of functionality, reliability, efficiency, usability, maintainability, and portability.

articleTitle: Parametric Optimization of Microstrip Patch Antenna Design for Enchanced Performance at 3.5 GHz Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: This paper focuses on the parametric optimization of a microstrip patch antenna design for enhanced performance in 3.5 GHz wireless applications. Utilizing Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) as the substrate material. The substrate, with a thickness of 1.6 mm and a relative permittivity, εr of 2.1, meticulous design considerations are employed to optimize antenna performance. Simulation conducted via Computer Simulation Technology (CST) Studio Suite software showcases a gain of 6.823 dBi at the antenna's resonant frequency of 3.5 GHz. Furthermore, the observed return loss, S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> is −22.80 dB, with an impedance bandwidth characterized by return loss below −10 dB spanning from 3.47 GHz to 3.53 GHz. Notably, the VSWR value of 1.15 indicates efficient impedance matching. The integration of CST software in the simulation process enhances the precision and reliability of the results, providing valuable insights into the design and performance characteristics of microstrip patch antennas.

articleTitle: The Potential of Embodied Social Presence in VR News for Reducing Cyber Violence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Cyber violence is a significant societal challenge in today's society, leading to psychological trauma and social consequences for the victims. This study explores the potential of integrating Embodied Social Presence in VR News as a novel approach to address this issue. Through a comprehensive literature analysis and interview survey, the study identifies current limitations in VR news related to topics and technology. However, ESP's interactive and embodied elements can effectively stimulate empathy and reduce cyber violence. The immersive, interactive, and embodied features of ESP allow users to experience events firsthand, making it a crucial factor in reducing cyber violence. Therefore, the application of ESP to VR news holds promise in offering innovative solutions for combating cyber violence.

articleTitle: Enhanced Digital Forensic Model for Securing the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: The implementation of Secure Forensic investigation process by digitally using loT will result in the connecting of many wireless devices and exposes threat to security vulnerabilities. The data flow from Pre investigation to post investigation and storage or cloud-based targeting key areas of identity on abnormal activity checkingfootprints in to the server (pre investigation) once identified and proceed to post investigation with examination and saving the data into secure storage. The existing challenge in the development of a thorough inventory and classification system for loT devices lies in establishing a consistent method for regularly updating a database that encompasses device types, manufacturers, and communication protocols. The suggested loT forensic model underscores a comprehensive perspective, addressing not only the technical facets of investigation but also considering legal and procedural considerations along with adhering to standard procedures. An inadequacy has been found in the current digital forensic model based on loT. To address this notable gap, we have formulated an loT-centric digital forensic model. While the existing loT-based digital forensic model concentrates on both pre- and post-investigation stages, especially when anomalies are identified and securely recorded, encompassing detailed data such as IP addresses and geographical zones in the pre-investigation phase, our proposed model takes a comprehensive approach, spanning the entire investigation process. This includes the establishment of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) at the outset and the subsequent archival of evidence, covering the examination and secure storage of evidence on backup servers.

articleTitle: Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm in Multilevel Image Thresholding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: The principal challenge addressed in this paper is modifying the standard particle swarm optimization algorithm to achieve improved multilevel image thresholding performance. In this paper, a multilevel image thresholding method that relies on Kapur's entropy and the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is presented. The improved particle swarm optimization algorithm employs a particular nonlinearly decreasing inertia weight strategy and Gaussian mutation. The performance of the considered multilevel image thresholding method is assessed on five test images. The experimental results demonstrate the successful utilization of the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm for determining image thresholds across different images. This algorithm is shown to enhance the multilevel image thresholding performance over the standard particle swarm optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Characterization of Early Termination for Stochastic Computing Image Processing Circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Stochastic computing (SC) performance is signifi-cantly impacted by the length of the bitstream, which directly affects both computation time and throughput. Researchers have proposed early termination methods to reduce bitstream length, relying on stochastic bitstream patterns generated by stochastic number generators (SNGs). In this study, we investigate early termination specifically for median filter image processing ap-plications. We analyze several SNGs, including those based on ‘randperm,’ linear feedback shift registers (LFSR), Streaming Accurate (SA), and counter-based approaches. These SNGs are evaluated using different image inputs. Our experimental results demonstrate that early termination can be safely employed. Notably, the use of counter-based SNGs naturally facilitates early termination in median filter applications. By leveraging this approach, we achieve bitstream length reduction without sacrificing accuracy. The extent of reduction varies based on the specific image inputs. In summary, our findings highlight the effectiveness of early termination strategies, particularly when utilizing counter-based SNGs for median filter computations.

articleTitle: A Capacitor-Less Low-Dropout Regulator with PVT Compensated Adaptive Biasing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: This paper proposes a LDO (Low-Dropout) Regula-tor without an output capacitor using PVT (Process, Voltage, and Temperature) Compensated Adaptive Biasing circuit. To improve the current efficiency at the light load, the dual power transistors, and the Adaptive Biasing circuit are used, such that one of the power transistors and the Low-impedance Buffer are turned off at the light load. Besides, the overall bias current is reduced to 0.779 µA to improve the current efficiency at the light load. The proposed design is implemented with a typical 0.18 µm CMOS process. The core area is 474.3 × 730.53 µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The maximum output current is 20 mA. The peak efficiency of the LDO Regulator is 99.815%, and the current efficiency at the light load of 10 µA is 92.715%.

articleTitle: Bridging Gaps in High School Physics Education: Revolutionizing through Virtual Reality Experimental Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: In response to interruption in students' learning caused by unforeseen circumstances such as the COVID-19 pandemic, it is imperative that we bridge the gaps inherent in traditional classroom learning methods. This paper aims at revolutionizing high school physics education through the design of a virtual reality (VR) experimental learning system. The initiative not only imparts physics knowledge but also incorporates virtual experiments directly tied to the curriculum tailored for high school-level students. A survey study has been conducted to validate the application usability and collected insightful feedback that can be incorporated to enhance its efficacy. The results of 74.38 SUS scores showcase high satisfaction among the participants. The prototyping of this transformative application successfully offers a user-friendly alternative to traditional teaching methods to create an immersive and engaging experience for high school physics education.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization with Time-Varying Acceleration Coefficients in Multilevel Image Thresholding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Multilevel image thresholding based on the exhaustive search for the optimal thresholds is computationally expensive. To overcome this drawback this paper investigates the use of the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithms with time-varying acceleration coefficients in multilevel image thresholding. Specifically, two multilevel image thresholding methods based on Kapur's entropy and PSO algorithm with time-varying acceleration coefficients are considered. The two methods use different strategies to vary cognitive and social acceleration coefficients within the PSO algorithm. The considered thresholding methods are assessed on five test images. The multilevel image thresholding performance is assessed for varying numbers of thresholds. The performance of the methods under consideration is compared to that of the thresholding method based on the PSO algorithm with constant acceleration coefficients. The experimental results show that the thresholding methods based on the PSO algorithm with time-varying acceleration coefficients can be successfully used to obtain image thresholds across different test images.

articleTitle: Comparison of Impacts From Color-based and Geometric Augmentations for Deep Learning: A Case of Thai Food Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: This paper presents a study on the impacts of different augmentation techniques, which are roughly divided into color-based augmentation and geometric augmentation. It aims to guide researchers in considering and making informed decisions before applying each technique in further research. In this study, deep learning models from three transfer learning models—ResNet50, EfficientNetB0, and DenseNet121—were applied to a dataset consisting of eight types of Thai food images. The results indicate that the effects from double geometric augmentation, as defined in this study, are significantly more positive than those of the color-based augmentations. Following the analysis, it was observed that the performance of DenseNet121 with double geometric augmentation showed an increased accuracy of 6.13% compared to the performance obtained from the same model with double color-based augmentation.

articleTitle: Systematic Literature Review on Current Application of Utilizing Augmented Reality in Heritage Tourism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: This study reports an ongoing study related to the current application of utilizing Augmented Reality (AR) technology particularly in the heritage tourism sector. A systematic literature review (SLR) has been carried out by utilizing Kitchenham and Charters SLR guidelines. Three primary steps have been taken which are (i) planning review, (ii) conducting review, and (iii) reporting results. There are five major aspects have been analyzed which are the category of (i) AR and motivation, (ii) types of the heritage tourism sector, (iii) marker design, (iv) AR content, and (vi) the application context. The results from the SLR reveal that AR technology has the potential to greatly enhance the visitor experience, particularly in the Islamic tourism sector. Thus, the next stage of this study is to explore the development of AR applications for promoting Islamic heritage tourism through the concept of informal learning.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of Inception V3and Mo bileN et V2Models in Classifying Bird Species Based on Physical Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Birds are wildlife that are easily found in every environment. With bird populations growing in abundance but threatened by extinction, bird species identification is crucial for nature conservation efforts. Proper classification can provide a strong basis for protecting habitats and implementing effective conservation policies. This study uses a dataset consisting of 525 bird species with a total of 84,635 training images, 2625 test images, and 2625 validation images. Two Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures, namely Inception V3 and MobileN et V2, were compared to evaluate the effectiveness of using the model in classifying bird species. Previous studies have shown that the use of CNN s, especially the Inception Resnet V2 architecture, has resulted in high accuracy rates in bird species recognition. The results of this study show that MobileN et V2 achieved higher accuracy (94.93 %) compared to Inception V3 (91.16<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) in classifying bird species on the test dataset. The loss value of MobileNet V2 also tends to be lower, indicating better performance in training. These results can indicate that the Mobilenet V2 architecture model has an architecture or configuration that is more suitable for the characteristics of the test dataset used, resulting in better results in terms of accuracy and loss application of machine learning technology, especially CNN, provides new possibilities for detecting and identifying bird species efficiently. This research is expected to be a reference regarding accurate identification results, which can be used as a basis for understanding the population, habitat, and behavior of bird ecosystems. This research, which uses the Inception V3 and MobileN et V2 architecture models, is expected to contribute to the development of more efficient and accurate bird species identification methods in supporting nature conservation and wildlife protection efforts.

articleTitle: Handover Performance of Mobility Robustness Optimization for Beyond 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Mobility management is crucial for maintaining a dependable and steady connection in mobile communication networks, particularly when users are on the move. Within Self-Organization Networks (SON), the Self-Optimization function in-troduces Mobility Robustness Optimization (MRO) as a solution. MRO in SON aims to enhance handover efficiency by optimizing Handover Control Parameters (HCPs), such as hand over margin (HOM) and time-to-trigger (TTT). The increasing demand for high data rates has led to the widespread deployment of Small Base Stations (SBS) and Ultra Dense Networks (UDN) with Mil-limeter Wave (mmWave) technology, posing complex handover challenges. The paper investigates different HCP system settings for Beyond 5G (B5G) networks and analyzes their effects on performance indicators, such as handover probability (HOP) and handover ping-pong (HOPP). Result indicates using low HCP setting provide with high HOP and HOPP values. While high HCP setting gives low HOP and HOPP values. This shows each setting impacts the network performance.

articleTitle: Aspect-Based Subjectivity Analysis Using a BERT-based Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Aspect-based subjectivity analysis stands as an important task in natural language processing, seeking to identify the subjectivity of various aspects or features within a text. A new method for aspect-based subjectivity analysis using BERT is introduced in this paper. BERT has demonstrated impressive performance across various NLP tasks, and its capabilities are utilized to accurately ascertain the subjectivity of specific aspects within a given text. The approach involves fine-tuning BERT on a sizable dataset annotated with aspect-level subjectivity labels, enabling the model to grasp the subtleties of aspect-based subjectivity analysis. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets are conducted to showcase the effectiveness of this approach and compare it with existing methods. The results reveal that this proposed approach surpasses state-of-the-art techniques in aspect-based subjectivity analysis, underscoring the potential of leveraging BERT for such purposes.

articleTitle: Deposition of ZnO Nanoparticles on Cotton Textile for Wearable Electronics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Zinc oxide is vital in today's industry because of its unique properties, such as anti-corrosion, anti-bacteria, low electron conductivity, and high heat resistance. The purpose of this research is study the deposition of  ZnO nanostructures on cotton textile. Spin coating technique was applied to deposit the ZnO on cotton textile due to simple and cheap deposition method in thin film fabrication. Different ZnO thickness were applied in the deposition process to study its effect on the surface morphology and electrical properties. From the FE-SEM images, it is observed that the surface of the cotton textiles are fully covered with spherical-like ZnO nanoparticles. While the I-V characteristics showed that the ZnO nanoparticles are conductive on the cotton textile, and can be used as wearable textile.

articleTitle: Real-Time Pipeline Tracking System on a RISC-V Embedded System Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Pipeline infrastructures are the most suitable means of transporting oil and gas products, making these infrastructures demand reliable inspection methods to ensure their integrity and reliability. Current inspection techniques are labour-intensive, error-prone, safety-threatening, time-consuming, and limited coverage. This paper presents a real-time Pipeline Tracking System hosted on the RISC-V Embedded System Platform, aiming to automate the inspection process. The model was trained using the YOLOv7 algorithm, which is trained to detect and track pipelines and is deployed on the VisionFive 2 Single Board Computer, a RISC-V embedded system platform which offers capabilities in 3D image processing, making it an ideal platform for automated pipeline inspection in resource-constrained environments. The system is designed for integration with unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), providing an onboard computer for vision-based detection. Experimental results demonstrate compatibility in resource-constrained environments, emphasising computational efficiency and tracking accuracy. This work contributes to automating pipeline inspection processes, enhancing safety, and advancing RISC-V technology. Future work includes optimising computer vision performance and hardware implementation on a drone.

articleTitle: Hybrid Fixed and Floating-Point Approach for Implementing PID Controllers on Zynq-7000 FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: PID controllers are crucial for regulating various process variables such as temperature, flow, pressure, and speed in industrial control systems. Therefore, this paper aims to design and implement the real-time FPGA-based PI/PID controller, which is complex regarding memory issues, accuracy, resource utilization, and energy consumption. Thus, this research uses Matlab's hybridized fixed- and floating-point approach to design the module Xilinx Vivado. The proposed design is realized on a Zynq-7000 FPGA board, and the results of the PI/PID controller implemented on the FPGA Zynq-7000 board model are stimulated. System generator tools are used to generate the hardware description language code. The Xilinx Vivado tool checks the module's device utilization, timing analysis, and power consumption. The performance is improved in terms of dynamic range, speed, unlimited use of resources, efficiency, and less energy consumption.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of User Adoption of Hospital's WeChat Official Account
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Digital media, particularly social media, reshapes traditional media and makes information more accessible. Traditional outlets face challenges in the digital era, with declining demand for newspapers affecting hospitals' brand communication. In contrast, interactive social and digital media play crucial roles. This empirical study specifically investigates and explores the factors influencing the user adoption of a hospital's WeChat Official Account, utilizing survey methodology with 521 participants. Data analysis employs multiple regression analysis in SSPS 27. This study finds that determinants for Adoption are Trust in Healthcare Providers (TIHP), Perceived Brand Value by Clients (PBVC) Perceived Ease of Use (PEOU) and Perceive Usefulness (PU).

articleTitle: Real-Time FPGA-Based Sound Source Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Sound source localization (SSL) allows accurate location detection through sound signals in various applications. This work proposes an SSL method implemented on FPGA (Field-Programmable Gate Array) technology using the Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA) algorithm. The FPGA's high computational power and low latency facilitate rapid sound processing, enhancing the efficiency of SSL systems. The system employs strategically placed sound sensors to capture and analyze the time difference and computed angle processed on the DE1-SoC FPGA. The experiment used an input sound of 80 dB with a sound frequency range of 2.2 to 2.8 kHz. The results show that the accuracy of the FPGA is higher than the oscilloscope by having a smaller average angle error of ±2.29° (97.46% accuracy) compared to ±6.46° (92.82% accuracy). Overall, this study contributes to the practical use of FPGA technology in enhancing acoustic signal processing capabilities.

articleTitle: Human-in-the-Ioop Reinforcement Learning for Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Facial emotion recognition (FER) analyses a person's facial expressions in images to understand the person's emotions. Achieving high accuracy in real-world FER systems requires extensive data, which poses challenges in cost, practicability, and privacy, especially in ensuring fairness and avoiding discrimination related to skin color or health conditions. This paper introduces a novel approach called two-state Q-Iearning with human feedback (TS-QL-HF) to enhance the accuracy of a FER system by integrating human feedback collected during the evaluation process as a refined reward function into two-state Q-Iearning (TS-QL) and double Q-learning (DQL) to operate in deterministic environments. This approach does not need an extensive dataset to include minority populations. Simulation results demonstrate that TS-QL-HF provides the highest accuracy. However, the tuned TS-QL, without human feedback, shows a higher efficiency despite a slightly lower accuracy due to the inaccurate reward function.

articleTitle: Revolutionalizing Lung Disease Prediction using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into healthcare systems holds great promise for alleviating the burden of lung diseases on individuals and society. This study contributes to the growing body of evidence that supports the crucial role of AI in healthcare particularly in the prediction of lung diseases thereby potentially saving lives and advancing personalized medicine. The research investigates the potential of Machine Learning and Deep Learning models in accurately predicting and classifying lung diseases. By utilizing features extracted from chest X-ray images and Electronic Medical Records (EMR) data, the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithms demonstrate impressive performance in identifying lung diseases. Furthermore, a multi-stacking ensemble algorithm which combines KNN, SVM and CNN surpasses individual models achieving an outstanding accuracy of 98.3% and favorable evaluation metrics. These findings emphasize the importance of advanced computational techniques in revolutionizing healthcare practices enabling early detection, timely interventions, and improved patient outcomes. Besides practical considerations such as the feasibility of real-time deployment and computational efficiency need to be addressed for effective implementation in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Resource-Efficient 64-Bit Karatsuba Multiplier using LUTs and DSP Slices
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Modern Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is now equipped with Digital Signal Processing (DSP) block for faster computation. This feature can be exploited to speed-up the multiplication process which is widely needed during encryption. However, the operand size of DSP multipliers are asymmetric, 24 x 17 bits, thus complicates the multiplication process. As DSP has high-throughput function, it must be optimally used to avoid resource waste. Thus, 64-bit Karatsuba multiplier is proposed in this paper to exploit the DSP advancement, based on two optimizations: operand decomposition and operand arrangement. Both optimizations are tailored to the DSP asymmetric multiplier architecture. The proposed design is implemented on Kintex 7. We only utilized 8 DSP slices and several slices of LUTs resource, smaller than non-standard tiling Karatsuba. In fact, we achieved higher DSP efficiency (97.6%) as each DSP slice is optimally utilized.

articleTitle: Batik Image Retrieval using Convolutional Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Image retrieval systems have long been a cornerstone of multimedia databases, aiming to extract relevant images from vast datasets. Batik, an intricate traditional art form originating from Indonesia, presents unique challenges in this domain. Its diverse patterns and rich history have led to a broad array of designs, making the retrieval of specific Batik images a formidable task. This research paper introduces a novel approach that employs a convolutional auto encoder to address the challenges of Batik image retrieval. The underlying problem we address is the difficulty in obtaining high precision results from conventional image retrieval systems when dealing with the detailed patterns of Batik. Our methodology hinges on a convolutional autoencoder, a deep learning model adept at extracting pivotal features from images and using them for various tasks, including image retrieval. The effectiveness of our method was evaluated using the Batik Nitik dataset, a comprehensive collection of 960 images representing a wide range of Batik designs. The outcomes were promising. Our proposed method achieved a remarkable precision of 0.98, a testament to its capability in accurately retrieving relevant Batik images. Furthermore, this research not only demonstrates the potential of convolutional autoencoders in the realm of image retrieval but also offers a solution tailored to the unique intricacies of Batik. In conclusion, the convolutional autoencoder presents a groundbreaking approach to Batik image retrieval, merging traditional art with modern deep learning techniques to ensure accuracy and relevance in results.

articleTitle: Random Forest Regression Analysis for the Failure Prediction of Corrosion in Pipeline Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Pipeline failure prediction is crucial in ensuring optimal pipeline maintenance strategies. This work applies a Random Forest Regression model (RF) for failure prediction of pipeline using wall of thickness and depth of corrosion. It highlights the data cleaning procedures applied on the Inline Inspection Dataset (ILI), dimensionality reduction using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and evaluate the performance of different Random Forest Regression models using the coefficient of determination (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). Finally, a recommendation for further research is proposed.

articleTitle: Ocular Disease Recognition System Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Glaucoma and diabetic retinopathy are all ocular diseases that can cause significant vision loss and blindness. Early detection and treatment of these diseases is critical for vision preservation and preventing permanent vision damage. In recent years, deep learning techniques have been applied to ocular disease recognition with promising results, however the current system that available predict lower precision and it can lead to the poor decision making by ophthalmologist. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) particularly have been shown to be effective in recognising various ocular diseases from eye images. In this study, CNN was trained with 600 eye images to identify glaucoma and diabetic retinopathy. A supervised learning approach was used to train the model from beginning to end. To increase the model's precision, various image augmentation methods were applied. The outcome demonstrates that, after classification's evaluation, the model managed to obtain 97% accuracy value. In the future, this system can train and validate CNNs using larger datasets, as well as collect and use more diverse datasets of eye fundus images to improve the accuracy of the system.

articleTitle: Standalone Smart Glass System for the Blind and Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Blindness stands as one of the most prevalent and impactful disabilities, affecting millions of individuals globally. The present work focuses on developing a smart glass system meticulously designed to cater to the unique needs of the blind and visually impaired (BVI) community. Unlike existing solutions, the proposed smart glass operates as a standalone device, eliminating the need for constant internet connectivity or reliance on external devices such as smartphones or external processor for computational resources. The system comprises three key modules: object recognition, text recognition and face recognition, employing YOLOV8, KerasOCR and FaceNet, respectively. The hardware integrates a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W and Intel Neural Compute Stick 2, enabling efficient edge-based deep learning model execution. The YOLOV8 model is trained on ImageNet and a custom dataset for Malaysian currency, featuring 270 object classes. To enhance user interaction, offline speech recognition via Vosk-API is implemented, providing input and output through a build-in speaker and MEMS microphone. This multifunctional, lightweight and standalone smart glass system aims to empower the BVI community, fostering self-reliance and emphasising ability over disability.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Imaging for Remote Sensing and Agriculture: A Comparative Study of Transformer-based Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) is a powerful tool in remote sensing and precision agriculture, providing insights into material characteristics. This review, “Advancements in Hyperspectral Imaging for Remote Sensing and Agriculture,” explores recent HSI developments. It covers HSI fundamentals, including sensor design and data analysis. It delves into remote sensing applications like land cover classification and environmental monitoring. In precision agriculture, HSI aids crop health assessment and yield prediction. The paper addresses HSI challenges like data preprocessing and dimensionality reduction. It discusses integrating machine learning and deep learning to improve HSI analysis. Emerging technologies, such as compact HSI sensors, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), and satellite systems, are highlighted. This paper presented a comparison study of Transformer based models for HSI in contrast to traditional convolutional neural networks challenges and their benefits in noise cancellation, Robust Spectral pixel extraction and group pixel awareness. In conclusion, this review offers a comprehensive look at HSI's role in sustainable agriculture and remote sensing. It emphasizes ongoing research and HSI's potential to shape these fields, aiding decision-making and resource management.

articleTitle: A YOLO Benchmarking Experiment For Maritime Object Detection In Foggy Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: The maritime object detection in foggy conditions has been a major challenge in the field of computer vision due to its harsh environment. Compared to automatic detection in other domains, progress in this field has been slow, primarily due to the lack of benchmarking studies. In this study, we propose a benchmark study for maritime obj ect detection in foggy environments by combining the modified ABOships dataset and the efficient YOLO (You Only Look Once) model. We simulate foggy conditions using the principle of dark channel prior and modify the original dataset through class balancing and data augmentation techniques. Furthermore, through training and analysis, we select the state-of-the-art YOLOv5n model as the base model. The experimental results are encouraging, as the YOLO model trained using modified dataset demonstrates a notable improvement in mAPO.5 by 15.82% and mAPO.5:0.95 by 16.6%, respectively. Moreover, the proposed base model demonstrates superior stability compared to other models, achieving an mAPO.5 of 64.4% while requiring only 3.64 million parameters and 4.3 GFLOPs (Giga Floating Point Operations Per Second) of computational cost. This effectively demonstrates that the proposed methodology can be used as a reproducible basis for comparative evaluation in foggy maritime object detection, thereby advancing research in smart transportation services.

articleTitle: An Integrated AR Application with Creative Dental Health Illustration Book as a Learning Media for Children
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: Poor dental health is a significant public health concern, particularly among children. Caring for our dental health is a must for better health in adulthood. Studies in Malaysia found that the most common cases for children are tooth decay or cavities. However, there is currently a dearth of current and limited available educational materials for kids about oral health. Therefore, there is a need of new approach in developing a learning media about dental health for children that is effective and engaging. This development is carried out by using the ADDIE model which involves Analysis, Design, Development, and Evaluation. This effort is to support SDG4: Quality Education and SDG3: Good health and Wellbeing. This initiative to ensure inclusive and equitable quality education focusing on healthy loves and promote wellbeing for all at all ages. The data collection process involved the systematic use of quantitative research methods to gather valuable information. This comprehensive approach encompassed a study conducted in two distinct Sub-Urban areas located in Malaysia and Indonesia, namely the Klang Valley region in Malaysia and Jakarta in Indonesia. Preliminary research shows a lack of oral health illustrated books for youngsters in suburban locations. The findings suggest that the availability of a picture book that focuses on dental health can be of assistance to parents in the process of teaching their children about dental health.

articleTitle: Factors Influence the User's Intention to use Online Travel Agents
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: As a result of the Covid-19 pandemic and entering the New Normal period, there have been several changes in tourist behavior in using Online Travel Agents (OTA). This study proposes a research model by based on the success model from DeLone & McLean for information system with the variables Perceived Risk and Trust to aim to find out what factors influence the user's intention to use OTA. Data testing was carried out using the PLS-SEM method application with a sample of 509 valid respondents who were collected through a survey. In this study, perceived risk has a negative effect on trust, while information quality and trust positively influence user satisfaction, which has a positive impact on intention to reuse OTA sites. With these findings, companies must provide a satisfying experience for users to be interested in using OTA sites as part of their travel planning. According to the findings of several studies, the level of customer satisfaction is impacted by the quality of information provided. Consequently, it is imperative for Online Travel Agencies (OTAs) to possess the capability of providing precise and up-to-date information.

articleTitle: Enhancing Aviation Safety: A Deep Learning-based Fault Detection System for Jet Engines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: The reliable detection of faults and anomalies in aircraft engines is vital for ensuring aviation safety and operational efficiency. Traditional methods often struggle with the complexity of data from modern engines, necessitating innovative approaches. In recent years, deep learning, particularly Deep Neural Networks (DNN), has shown promise in revolutionizing fault detection. This paper aims to explore and implement DNN- based models for aircraft engine failure detection. Leveraging DNN's capabilities for handling high-dimensional data and creating non-linear decision boundaries, the proposed system seeks to enhance safety, reduce maintenance costs, and improve operational efficiency in aviation utilizing DNN-based model development. Rigorous training and validation will ensure efficiency, accuracy, and robustness. The system's integration allows for real-time monitoring and precise detection of rare and critical engine failures. The results show the contribution of the proposed method to aviation safety for fault detection, promising proactive maintenance, operational excellence, and heightened confidence in passenger safety.

articleTitle: Genius City Mechanism to Improve Sustainable Ecosystems, Education, Transportation, Governance, and Commerce
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 14th Symposium on Computer Applications & Industrial Electronics (ISCAIE)
abstract: With the expansion of urban cities, there are major issues that prevent improving lives to a better living. The poor and partially systematic government systems, education, transportation, and economic structures present a difficult challenge in urban settings, badly affecting the quality of life and environmental sustainability. Inefficient governance negatively impacts the delivery of public services which has led to illuminate citizen trust. The insufficiencies in education and transportation further worsen socio-economic situations, limiting opportunities and delaying social mobility.
